prompts.prompt:
Create one production-ready transparent PNG game building sprite for RimWorld / Odyssey, TWO COLUMNS WIDE by THREE ROWS TALL, portrait 1024x1536. Pure orthographic straight top down, north at top. It is a spacecraft INTERIOR CARGO ELEVATOR LOADING PORT, NOT a tall cargo box. Reference image 1 shows the simple upright ancient security terminal design language; reference 2 shows our existing detachable cooling module, ONLY use its grey mechanical style and connection size, DO NOT draw the cooling module installed.

Exact layout: top one-third (top row) has TWO distinct units. Left half is a freestanding UPRIGHT rectangular security computer pedestal, grey cabinet with a raised vertical back and a broad pale neutral-grey display/control face along its SOUTH/bottom edge facing a person standing directly below it. Resembles the Odyssey ancient terminal: boxy, blunt, readable, a simple standing console with a short pedestal, few chunky buttons, NOT a flat touchscreen lying on the ground. Right half is an EMPTY square cooling expansion socket: a dark recessed square mounting plate sized to accept a module covering 70 percent of that cell, with two clearly visible thick plumbing pipes bending around the outer top/right edges and ending in couplers; unmistakably an unused expansion connection, no fan, no installed machinery.

Bottom TWO THIRDS is a flat 2x2-cell square elevator hatch/loading platform at floor level, WALKABLE. Broad clean grey hatch leaves with one understated center seam and simple lift rails around the perimeter, no tall box walls. On the lower part of the hatch is ONE large long dark EMPTY recessed horizontal capacity display strip, roughly 1.4 cells wide and 0.25 cells high, centered at image x=50%, y=78%. Do NOT bake any fill level bars into this strip; we will draw live fill over it. Four small corner emitters create clean narrow CYAN cargo alignment laser guide lines / L-shaped loading guides INSIDE the platform perimeter, readable at game scale but restrained, no huge glow. Keep the left-middle cell empty/walkable so a pawn can stand there facing the top-left console.

Visual style: the medium-detail sweet spot between vanilla RimWorld and the supplied cooling module. Clean bold near-black silhouette and internal outlines, neutral medium grey shell, a few large lighter flat planes and thin bevel highlights; flat hand-drawn game icon shading, no photorealistic textures, no noise, no grunge, no microbolts, no tiny vents, no perspective or isometric camera. Keep the main terminal panel and hatch panels neutral near-white/grey for subsequent two-channel tint mask. Do not color the whole object blue. Do not add text, symbols, arrows, locks, floors outside the object, grid lines, labels or backgrounds. Use actual alpha transparency. Outer footprint nearly fills the 2:3 canvas with minimal equal padding, sharply aligned rectangular geometry. The upper row modules are visually distinct and the lower square is clearly a loading elevator, not another box.
